 Sione Vaki , RB (DET) 
 Suiting up in Week 10
 Home   >  News 
 Nov 15 1:08pm 
 Vaki (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich.
 Vaki is playing through an ankle issue for a second straight contest, but last Sunday at Miami he was able to handle an above average 34 percent snap share, indicating he again is good to serve as Jahmyr Gibbs' top backup. On the season, such a workload has amounted to 37 touches for 199 yards from scrimmage and no TDs in eight appearances for Vaki.
